title: Vitki: an open platform for the analysis of runic inscriptions
description:
Open research platform for runic inscriptions (Swedish title: Vitki: öppen plattform för analys av runinskrifter). It measures carving grooves automatically in 3D scans of recognised runes, with uncertainty, provenance and a published list of known limitations; integrates the Scandinavian Runic-text Data Base (Rundata); offers orthographic stylometry and a calibrated carver-attribution model tested on signed stones; keeps a shared measurement corpus; compares stones statistically; runs corpus statistics in R under pre-registered, checksum-locked analysis plans; and publishes research reports, carver pages, maps of the old lands, reports in eleven publication formats and an RTI (PTM) viewer. Methods are described in METHODS.md, the measurement protocol in PROTOCOL.md.

Code: GPL-3.0 with additional terms (see NOTICE). Data from other sources included in the archive keep their own licences (Rundata ODbL 1.0/DbCL 1.0, OpenStreetMap ODbL, 3D scans and SGU data CC BY 4.0, RuneS-DB and Wikipedia CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikidata, Swedish National Heritage Board and Statistics Sweden data CC0); see README.md, section “Data och innehåll från andra källor”.
